segments.text: In the first awakening, it was in the explanation of Shambho Paya.
In the second, it was of Shaktho Paya.
And in this third, now we will be explained on O Paya.
In the first awakening, in the first Sutra of the first awakening,
is the definition of your own Self.
And in the second awakening, in this first Sutra of second awakening also,
he has defined the reality of Self.
And in third also, he explains the reality of Self.
But there is difference in these three explanations.
First explanation is because the Self there is situated in Shambho Paya,
in his real way of being.
So there he has put Chaitanya Mahatma, first Sutra.
God consciousness is the reality of Self.
Chaitanya means God consciousness, independent God consciousness.
In the second awakening of Shubha Sutra, he has put Chittam Mantra,
not Self, the mind.
He has gone a bit down from being to the experience of impressions, of thoughts.
So he is residing there in the world of mind, not in the world of his real nature.
But his mind is so purified there, that his mind has become the embodiment of mantras,
all mantras.
The embodiment of all mantras is aham, i-consciousness, supreme i-consciousness.
And in this third awakening, he has again explained the formation of Self.
And that Self is absolutely one with limited state of thought, mind.
Now he will explain that in this Sutra.
Yidhanyam, Anupayam, Pratipipya, the issue, Anotavat, Surupam, Darshiyati.
And now while explaining the third awakening of Shubha Sutras, Anupayam,
he puts forth the formation of individual being.
Anotavat, Surupam, Anomins, individual being.
The formation of individual being is explained in this Sutra.
